title: AI Traffic Funeral Kit
oneLiner: A darkly funny creator tool that turns disappearing Google traffic into a shareable “what died, what pivots” recovery ritual.
targetUser: Niche bloggers, indie publishers, affiliate-site owners, SEO consultants, newsletter writers, and creators watching search clicks vanish into AI answers.
keyUx: Paste Search Console snapshots, top losing pages, AI Overview screenshots, audience emails, newsletter CTAs, and monetized links; the app stages a mock funeral for dead pages, identifies survivor assets, suggests repackaging moves, and exports a memeable recovery card.

externalSignals.title: 9to5Google / Axios data — Google Search traffic to publishers has plummeted while AI referrals are under 1%
Reddit r/google — can we please get rid of AI overview

stitchPrompt: Design a bold creator recovery concept called AI Traffic Funeral Kit for niche bloggers, indie publishers, affiliate-site owners, SEO consultants, newsletter writers, and creators watching search clicks vanish into AI answers. Users should paste Search Console snapshots, top losing pages, AI Overview screenshots, audience emails, newsletter CTAs, and monetized links, then stage a mock funeral for dead pages, identify survivor assets, suggest repackaging moves, and export a memeable recovery card. Include a traffic obituary intake, dead-page memorial wall, AI answer theft theater, survivor asset triage, newsletter rescue CTA builder, repackage move spinner, and shareable recovery card. Design direction: use a playful-experimental aesthetic with gothic editorial humor, black-and-cream contrast, neon resurrection accents, theatrical cards, and one clear pivot-from-grief-to-action interaction so the product feels funny, shareable, and useful instead of just another SEO dashboard.
